title: Graduate School of Engineering and Natural Sciences Application Announcements (2026-2027 Spring MSc and PhD)
institution: Sabancı University, Graduate School of Engineering and Natural Sciences

compensation.value: Monthly stipend and/or tuition waiver (decided by the Admissions Committee)
compensation.evidence_quote: Financial support is available in the form of a monthly stipend and/or tuition waiver.

about: Sabancı University invites applications to its engineering and natural sciences MSc and PhD programmes for the 2026-2027 spring semester by 27 November 2026. Financial support is available as a monthly stipend and/or tuition waiver; interviews run 7-25 December 2026.
requirements: PhD applicants may apply with a BA or MA degree
Online application system only; emailed applications are not evaluated
